description: This Java source file defines the 'GlobalCommandResponseRegistry' class, which is a singleton registry for deserializing subclasses of 'CommandResponse' from JSON objects and headers, used within the Eclipse Ditto project to handle command response deserialization strategies.

classes.name: GlobalCommandResponseRegistry
classes.description: A singleton registry class for managing deserialization strategies of CommandResponse subclasses based on JSON type and annotations.

classes.name: CommandResponseParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: A nested factory class for creating deserialization strategies for CommandResponse objects based on JSON annotations.
